methods.name: Blundell-Bond system GMM (one-step, two-step)
methods.reference: plm::pgmm(transformation = 'ld', fsm = 'full', effect = 'individual'); plm::vcovHC.pgmm; plm::sargan; plm::mtest
methods.tolerance: validation/README.md with n = equations used: n > 1000 (1100-1642) coefficients 1e-10, SE and statistics 1e-8; n = 900, 995: 1e-8 and 1e-6 relative; counts exact

deviations.quantity: system GMM with lags >= 3 or min_lag >= 4
deviations.note: plm 2.6.7 pgmm(transformation = 'ld') fills its level-instrument matrix from a vector of the wrong length (R warns 'data length [36] is not a sub-multiple or multiple of the number of rows [5]'); p2a uses y_{t-1} - y_{t-2} for every level equation, as pgmm does for lags <= 2 and min_lag <= 3, pinned to the estimator written out in R (.sys_spec in econ_sysgmm.R, checked there against pgmm on the other fits)
refused for system GMM: pgmm's summary(robust = FALSE) one-step SEs are sqrt(diag(m$B1)), without sigma^2 and with a 1/N factor, and the H weight is the error covariance only when var(eta_i) = 0
